---
title: "Introduction to Climate Modeling"
subtitle: "Columbia Climate School · Fall 2026"
---

Earth system and climate models are critically important tools for climate science — used to study past climate variability, attribute recent trends and extremes, and project the evolution of the climate system under natural and anthropogenic forcing. This course opens the machine: you will **build** the hierarchy of climate models yourself in Python, **understand** how full Earth System Models work, **analyze** their output (CMIP6) the way practicing scientists do, and learn to **judge** what models can and cannot tell you.
